projects.title: EU Food Regulation Intelligence
projects.description: RAG pipeline that parses 243 EU food regulations, routes products to applicable laws deterministically, and extracts compliance checklists with zero hallucinations.

projects.title: Private Label Opportunity Engine
projects.description: Analyses 2.57M EU food products to identify where retailers can launch health-positioned private label products into underserved nutritional gaps.

projects.title: Steam Market Gap Analysis
projects.description: Multi-source data pipeline and hybrid recommendation engine that identifies underserved game niches on Steam, scoring 140,000+ market opportunities with revenue estimates.

projects.title: JobSearch Agent
projects.description: AI-powered CLI tool that automates job hunting: searches the web for relevant positions, intelligently filters based on your background, and generates tailored cover letters as professional PDFs.

projects.title: Fraud Detection
projects.description: Cost-sensitive fraud detection achieving 97.4% AUC and $447K annual savings. Features time-based CV and business-optimized thresholds.

projects.title: Wine exports/imports visualisation
projects.description: A data viz project to create an interactive world map showing wine imports and exports. Can also map other traded commodities using the UN's Comtrade data.

projects.title: TAORG
projects.description: The Animal Opposite Rhyming Game is a game I've been playing with my children for years. I decided to make a wordle-style web app based on it. Have a go!

projects.title: Macaroni
projects.description: SaaS product for SEO productivity incorporating ML features. I developed the backend (Python), database (BigQuery) and prototype frontend (Retool) whilst working at Blink SEO.

projects.title: JobMaster
projects.description: A job-queue system for triggering backend Python tasks from a web application. Created whilst working at Blink SEO to fill a need for a scalable and reliable system with a flexible API.

projects.title: PyGoogalytics
projects.description: A Python package for standardising and exporting Google Analytics, Google Ads, and Search Console data as a Pandas DataFrame, ready for analysis or storage. Created whilst working at Blink SEO.

projects.title: PS Indicator Robustness
projects.description: Analytical foundation for power spectrum indicator. Proves robustness against trends and periodic oscillations. Applied to paleoclimate ice-core data. Published in ERL.

projects.title: Early Warning Signals
projects.description: PhD research on detecting early warning signals for critical transitions. Developed novel methods applied to climate data and tropical cyclones. Published in EPL, Chaos, and ERL.

projects.title: Multivariate EWS
projects.description: Extending early warning signals to multivariate and gridded data. Developed stochastic hurricane model and spatial analysis methods. Published in Chaos.

projects.title: Power Spectrum Scaling Indicator
projects.description: Novel power spectrum scaling indicator for early warning signals. Applied to tropical cyclone prediction where traditional indicators fail. Published in EPL.

projects.title: Adaptive Mesh Generation
projects.description: MRes thesis on adaptive mesh generation using optimal transport and the Monge-Ampère equation. Developed a novel parameter-free linearisation method for numerical weather prediction.

projects.title: PrettyMath Games
projects.description: A series of games I made during my time teaching Maths to High School students.

projects.title: Digraph Explorer
projects.description: A tool for my undergraduate dissertation. Explore directed graphs and calculate the number of paths through them.
